exposure: International Association of the Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria
cohort: 500 pregnant women screened for GDM using the CC criteria between April 2006-March 2007, and 733 pregnant women screened using the IADPSG criteria between April 2013-March 2014.
finding: There was a statistically significant difference in maternal and neonatal outcomes when using the newer IADPSG criteria for the diagnosis of GDM compared to the CC criteria.
mod_finding: Women in the CC group had a higher rate of operative vaginal delivery (16.67% vs. 6.6%, p=0.085).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was higher in the CC group (3.10 +/- 0.55 kg) compared to the IADPSG group (2.97 +/- 0.48 kg, p=0.165).
